x_snc_airop_check_definition.ai_justification: Performance Analytics indicators provide the historical trend data Now Assist uses for predictive scoring and anomaly detection. Instances with no PA indicators have no trend baseline for AI analysis.
x_snc_airop_check_definition.remediation_guidance: Create Performance Analytics indicators for key ITSM metrics (incident volume, MTTR, SLA compliance) via pa_indicators_list.do. Configure scheduled data collection. Target: 10+ active indicators. PA data is the historical baseline Now Assist uses for trend-based AI insights.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[Performance Analytics indicators provide the historical trend data Now Assist uses for predictive scoring and anomaly detection. Instances with no PA indicators have no trend baseline for AI analysis.]]></ai_justification><check_name>Performance Analytics Indicators</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(checkDef, dateFilter) {
    var ga = new GlideAggregate('pa_indicators');
    ga.addQuery('active', true);
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.query();
    var count = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT')) : 0;

    var actualValue = count + ' active PA indicators';

    if (count >= 10) {
        return {
            status: 'ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: count + ' active PA indicators. Now Assist has sufficient historical trend baseline for predictive scoring and anomaly detection.'
        };
    } else if (count >= 3) {
        return {
            status: 'needs_attention',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'Only ' + count + ' active PA indicators (target: 10+). Limited PA coverage reduces Now Assist trend analysis depth — configure indicators for key ITSM metrics.'
        };
    } else {
        return {
            status: 'not_ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'Only ' + count + ' active PA indicators. Insufficient historical trend baseline — Now Assist predictive scoring and anomaly detection will default to point-in-time analysis only.'
        };
    }
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>PLATFORM</module><number>CHK0002989</number><order>60</order><remediation_guidance>Create Performance Analytics indicators for key ITSM metrics (incident volume, MTTR, SLA compliance) via pa_indicators_list.do.
